note: L2 — framework-neutral component catalogue for the Flare IM UI Kit. Each component is one contract (props/states/events + host-owned data source), realised natively per platform. Grounded in the current @flare-im/vue-ui reference implementation (props/events extracted from source).

contentTypes.note: MessageBubble/MessageContentView dispatch body rendering to a per-content-type view via a registry. Products register new types here.

capabilityFields.supportsConfiguration: Derived from public props and events.
capabilityFields.supportsCustomActions: The public contract accepts host-owned action items or action extensions.
capabilityFields.supportsCustomContent: The public contract accepts host-owned renderers, content, or replaceable regions.
capabilityFields.supportsSlots: At least one platform exposes a targeted slot, builder, composable lambda, or ViewBuilder.
capabilityFields.supportsCapabilities: Business availability is supplied through a capability contract instead of inferred by the view.
capabilityFields.supportsResponsive: The component changes presentation at real container breakpoints while preserving semantics.
capabilityFields.supportsDensity: The component takes a density of its own (its prop says what the values mean); the kit has no global density scale.

notes.en: 60fps virtualised; O(visible); scroll anchoring on append/prepend. toggle-select exists only on Vue and Flutter (onToggleSelect); iOS and Compose do not offer it yet. locateMessage: every list scrolls to a loaded quoted message itself and raises onLocateMessage only for one that is not loaded; the host pages it in and then asks the list to show it — `scrollToMessage(id)`, which answers whether the list had that message. Vue exposes that method on the component instance; the three native kits take a host-held handle (`controller`, Compose `state`). Two rules the handle carries: a row answers to two ids — the one it is drawn with and the core's id for it (`serverId`) — so the host hands `scrollToMessage` exactly what `onLocateMessage` gave it and translates nothing; and the handle answers for the pass the list last drew, so the host yields one of its own builds before asking. A quote always names the quoted message by the core's id for it, which is the id every other client knows it by. The trip itself is the kit's too: `flareLocateMessage` / `FlareLocate.run` asks the list, reads a page of older history through the host's callback, lets the list draw and asks again — 24 pages at most, then six more asks — and ends as shown, notInHistory or cancelled (`spec/locate-orchestration-vectors.json`). A host supplies how a page is read and the words for a miss, not the loop. The row a jump lands on is then marked for one window so the reader can see which row it was: `spec/locate-highlight-vectors.json` holds the window (1600 ms) and the three stops of the ring the four kits draw behind the bubble, one row marked at a time, and a second jump moves the mark rather than adding one. Reduce Motion holds the ring still instead of removing it — a reader who asked for less motion still has to be told where the jump landed. The mark is the sighted half of the answer; the other half is spoken. When a jump lands, the list announces which row it reached — the sender and the same one line a reply strip would show (`flareLocatedAnnouncement`) — through each platform's own announcement channel. Where a platform can move the reading cursor without changing how everyone else navigates, the jump takes the reader there too — Vue through the timeline's roving tabindex, SwiftUI through `@AccessibilityFocusState`; Flutter and Compose announce only, because moving the cursor there would mean making every row focusable. The return is each platform's idiom for the same answer: sync on Flutter and SwiftUI, `Promise<boolean>` on Vue, `suspend` on Compose. swipeReply: dragging a row towards the trailing edge starts a reply to it (leading edge under RTL). One rule on the three native kits, shared as `spec/swipe-reply-vectors.json`: only that direction counts, the list's own vertical scrolling wins any drag whose horizontal travel is under 1.25 times its vertical travel, the row follows the finger to 56 and then resists at 0.35 and stops at 72, and 56 is where the gesture arms — the reply affordance reaches full strength exactly there, so the reader knows before letting go, and dragging back below it cancels. A notice, a recalled message and multi-select mode carry no swipe. The gesture is never the only way to reply: the message menu raises the same intent, and the host builds the same quote for both. Vue has no swipe — the web timeline is pointer-first and a horizontal touch drag there fights the list's own scrolling. Vue: `unreadFromId` draws UnreadDivider (which also starts a new sender run), and the header, footer, empty and unread-divider slots keep typing rows and states inside the timeline.
notes.zh: 60fps 虚拟化；O(visible)；追加 / 前插时锚定滚动位。toggle-select 目前只有 Vue 与 Flutter(onToggleSelect),iOS/Compose 尚未提供。locateMessage:四端列表都自己滚到已加载的被引用消息,只有未加载时才抛 onLocateMessage;宿主翻到那条之后请列表把它显示出来——`scrollToMessage(id)`,按列表画出来的行 id 回答有没有这条。Vue 把这个方法暴露在组件实例上,三个原生 kit 用宿主持有的句柄(`controller`,Compose 为 `state`)。两条规则:一行认两个 id——它被画出来时用的那个,和核心给它的那个(`serverId`),所以宿主把 `onLocateMessage` 给的 id 原样传回 `scrollToMessage`,不做任何换算;句柄按列表最近画的那一遍回答,所以宿主要先让自己的一次构建过去再问。引用永远用核心 id 指向被引用消息——那是别的客户端唯一认得的 id。这趟路本身也归 kit:`flareLocateMessage` / `FlareLocate.run` 先问列表,再经宿主回调翻一页历史,让列表画一遍再问——最多 24 页,之后再问六次——结局是 shown / notInHistory / cancelled(`spec/locate-orchestration-vectors.json`)。宿主提供「怎么翻一页」和「找不到时说什么」,不提供循环。落点那一行随后会被标记一个窗口,让读者看见跳到的是哪一条:`spec/locate-highlight-vectors.json` 规定窗口(1600 ms)与四端在气泡后面画的那一圈的三个停靠点;同一时刻只标记一行,再跳一次是把标记挪过去,不是多亮一行。Reduce Motion 下这一圈静止而不是消失——要求减少动效的读者同样需要知道跳到了哪里。标记是这个答案看得见的那一半,另一半是说出来的:落地时列表会播报跳到了哪一行——发送者,加上回复条会显示的那一句摘要(`flareLocatedAnnouncement`),各端走自己的播报通道。在能够「移动读屏光标又不改变其他人导航方式」的平台上,跳转还会把读者带过去——Vue 借时间线已有的 roving tabindex,SwiftUI 用 `@AccessibilityFocusState`;Flutter 与 Compose 只播报,因为在那两端移动光标意味着把每一行都变成可聚焦的。返回值按各端习惯:Flutter 与 SwiftUI 同步,Vue 是 Promise,Compose 是挂起函数。swipeReply:把一行往尾边方向拖动开始回复它(RTL 下是前边)。三个原生 kit 同一条规则,共享表是 `spec/swipe-reply-vectors.json`:只认这一个方向;横向位移不足竖向 1.25 倍时让位给列表自己的滚动;行跟手到 56,之后按 0.35 阻尼、最多 72;56 是上膛点——回复图标正好在这里到达满强度,所以松手前读者就知道会触发,拖回去则取消。系统提示行、已撤回消息、多选模式都没有侧滑。侧滑永远不是唯一的回复入口:消息菜单抛的是同一个意图,宿主为两者构造同一条引用。Vue 没有侧滑——网页时间线以指针为先,横向触摸拖拽会和列表自身的滚动打架。Vue:`unreadFromId` 画出 UnreadDivider(同时开启新的发送者分组),header、footer、empty、unread-divider 插槽让输入中行与各状态留在时间线里。

notes.en: Responsibility boundary (2.0.0-rc.1): the composer owns the draft, panels and keyboard and composes the parts — ComposerReplyStrip, ComposerSendButton, MentionPicker and ComposerActionPanel are public, the upload strip / format strip / voice panel are private. Uploads stay host-owned (`uploadItems` in, `retryUpload` / `removeUpload` out); the mention roster is host-provided; microphone access goes through the injectable voice-recorder adapter (`provideFlareVoiceRecorder`, default = web MediaRecorder), never through the browser directly; file drops hand `File[]` to the host. Send results: Flutter `onSend` returns `FutureOr<bool>` (busy while pending, clears only on true); Compose hoists the text with `value` / `onValueChange` and iOS with the `text` binding, so hosts restore a failed send themselves. Vue offers voice only with `sendVoiceHandler` or a send-voice listener, and then shows the microphone in both toolbar presets.

Compose takes headerActions for host actions at the end of its header. The join policy is `FlareGroupJoinPolicy` (open, approval, invite); an unknown policy reads as not set and the picker opens with nothing selected, and `setJoinPolicy` carries the picked policy. notes.en: Presented, not placed by hosts: Vue `useFlareToast` (rendered by FlareUiProvider), Flutter `FlareToast.show(context, ...)`, iOS `FlareFeedback.toast` under `flareFeedbackHost`, Compose `LocalFlareToast.current.show(...)` under `FlareToastHost`. Same behaviour everywhere: at most 3 on screen (a new one removes the oldest), 4 s by default and 6 s for danger, 0 keeps it until its action or close, a close control, the action dismisses the toast, the message is announced politely, and show returns a function that dismisses early.
notes.zh: 由呈现器负责，宿主不摆放：Vue `useFlareToast`（由 FlareUiProvider 渲染）、Flutter `FlareToast.show(context, ...)`、iOS `flareFeedbackHost` 下的 `FlareFeedback.toast`、Compose `FlareToastHost` 下的 `LocalFlareToast.current.show(...)`。各端行为一致：同时最多 3 条（新的挤掉最旧的）、默认 4 秒、危险语气 6 秒、0 表示直到执行动作或关闭、带关闭控件、执行动作即关闭、以礼貌方式播报，show 返回提前关闭的函数。

notes.en: One item model on four kits: the shared action descriptor (`FlareActionItem`; Vue's generic base of composer and header actions). One grouping rule: host order is kept, a separator comes before an item whose group differs from the last group seen. Selecting an available item closes the menu, then reports its id. Vue renders its own ARIA menu (anchored through a popover, or a bottom sheet); Flutter the same through `FlareActionMenu(builder:)` or `FlareActionMenu.show(context, items:, label:, anchor:)`; iOS wraps the system `Menu` (`ActionMenuView`, fixed order, a check and the selected trait for pressed items); Compose a kit-styled dropdown placed in the trigger's Box (`ActionMenu(expanded, items, onDismiss, onSelect)`). The kit's own row, header and message menus are built on it.
notes.zh: 四端同一个条目模型：共享的操作描述（`FlareActionItem`；在 Vue 中是输入框操作与头部操作的泛型基类）。同一条分组规则：保持宿主顺序，条目的分组与上一个分组不同时在它之前画分隔线。选中可用条目会先关闭菜单再回报 id。Vue 自己渲染 ARIA 菜单（经弹出层锚定，或底部面板）；Flutter 通过 `FlareActionMenu(builder:)` 或 `FlareActionMenu.show(context, items:, label:, anchor:)` 同样实现；iOS 封装系统 `Menu`（`ActionMenuView`，固定顺序，pressed 条目带勾与 selected 特性）；Compose 为放在触发器 Box 里的组件库样式下拉菜单（`ActionMenu(expanded, items, onDismiss, onSelect)`）。组件库自己的会话行、头部与消息菜单都基于它。
